page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top right. Signature at the lower left and catchword at the lower right, below the last line. No margin notes.

main_text.head: ARTICULUS IX. De SS. Trinitate.
main_text.p: HÆc vero omnia cognoscimus tam ex Sacræ Scripturæ Testimonijs, quam ex Effectis, ijs potissimum, quæ nos in nobismet ipsis sentimus. Et sacræ quidem Scripturæ Testimonia, quæ nos docent sacram hanc Trinitatem credere, passim in Veteri Testamento occurrunt; quæ non tam numeranda, quam certo judicio seligenda sunt. Qualia hæc sunt, Geneseos primo dicit DEVS, Faciamus hominem ad imaginem & similitudinem nostram, &c. Et mox, Creavit itaque DEVS hominem ad imaginem & similitudinem suam, marem, inquam, & fœminam creavit eos. Item, Ecce Adam tanquam unus nostrum factus est. Ex eo enim quod dicitur, Faciamus hominem ad similitudinem nostram, apparet pluralitatem esse Personarum in Deitate. Quum autem dicitur, DEVS creavit, &c. indicatur unitas Divinitatis. page.notes: Drop cap H joined to Æc as "HÆc". Printed "&" kept as an ampersand. DEVS is set in small capitals in the original and is copied as capitals. Paragraph breaks: no line ends short of the margin, so the page is one paragraph. Catchword "obscu-" is the half word at the lower right. Signature "C 2" at the foot. Printed spellings such as "ijs", "Testimonijs" and "fœminam" are kept as printed.
